caption: שתים עשרה
en: a long row of many tall standing stones of the same size at the foot of a mountain, no people, no text (twelve stones)

caption: שלוש
en: only three tall standing stones in a field at the foot of a mountain, no people, no text (three stones)

caption: ארבעה עשר
en: a very long row of even more tall standing stones at the foot of a mountain, no people, no text (fourteen stones)

caption: מפה
en: a rolled ancient map with blank lines and a red mark, no people, no text (map)

caption: ספר הברית
en: an ancient man in a simple robe reading aloud from a big scroll to a crowd of seated men, only men, no letters visible, no text (the book of the covenant)

caption: מכתב מפרעה
en: a sealed royal letter with a red wax seal on a stone table, no people, no text (letter from pharaoh)

caption: נעשה ונשמע
en: a crowd of men in simple robes all raising their right hands together with happy smiling faces, only men, no text (we will do and listen)

caption: לא עכשיו
en: a crowd of men with arms crossed and heads turned away, shaking their heads, only men, no text (not now)

caption: אחר כך
en: a crowd of men sitting on the ground looking at the sky and thinking, only men, no text (later)

caption: כל העם
en: a big crowd of men standing together at the foot of a mountain, only men, no text (all the people)

caption: הזקנים
en: a group of old men with white beards standing together halfway up a mountain slope, only men, no text (the elders)

caption: משה
en: one single man in a simple robe climbing alone up the path of a mountain covered in cloud, only the one man in this panel, no text (moses alone)
